responsibility: Implements the fixed-point extension header from ISO TR 18037 by exposing the fixed-point keywords fract, accum, and sat and by publishing the compile-time precision, range, and epsilon macros for the signed and unsigned short, regular, long, and GCC-extension long long _Fract/_Accum families. Its role is to surface GCC’s target-provided fixed-point type characteristics through predefined macros, rather than to define arithmetic operations themselves.
